about: Polydance's look, in one place: every colour any platform paints with, the avatar colours, the type and the wood. The headset app (app/android .../Retro.kt), the Swift palette the Mac and the iPhone share (mac/Sources/PolydanceShared/Palette.swift), the receiver's pages (src/server/privacy.ts) and the polydance.net homepage (site/) take their values from here, and tests/design.test.ts fails when one of them drifts. docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md says what the look is and how each platform draws it.
avatarRule: A person's own colour when they have one; otherwise avatars[(javaStringHashCode(who) & 0x7fffffff) % avatars.length], so a person has the same colour on every platform.

label.use: printed labels: section names, keys, tags, lamps (lamps 0.24, keys 0.12)

fonts.mac: the system font at condensed width, Courier New
fonts.site: Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed, Arial Narrow, then system-ui: polydance.net (site/) takes the condensed sans the visitor's system already has, and downloads none

wood.seam: 2 px woodSeam, then a 1 px highlight rgba(255, 240, 214, 90/255) 1.6 px below

parts.about: Colours inside the drawn parts, from the headset app's drawing code (RetroViews.kt VuMeter, DeckViews.kt Lamp, RecordKey, RollingCounter and DeckView's reels, Surfaces.kt Screws). Pairs are gradients, top or centre first. The reels (2026-11-07, for the iPhone's top plate): the tape wound on them, red once the allowance is full; the clear flange is reelFlange at 40/255 and its windows reelRim at 150/255; the orange label (orange) has a reelLabelRim edge, the hub is reelHub with whitePrint teeth, and the ballerina is printed on the right reel's label in reelLogoInk. tapeFullPrint is the storage readout once the tape is full. The meter's OFF/ON switch (VuMeter.drawSwitch, 2026-11-12 for the Vision Pro): the unlit word in switchOffPrint (the lit one is whitePrint), the bushing's hex nut and its hole, the bat lever's dark edge and bright steel, and its rounded tip.
